text: The Fish Eagle opened his wings, casting a dark shadow over the assembly.
'The water is low, and meat is scarce,' he shrieked.
'By the law of the sky, the largest wings must have the first and deepest pools!
The small birds may pick what falls upon the mud once our bellies are filled.'
The Marabou Stork clattered his massive bill in greedy approval, stepping forward to claim the deepest fishing pool where the prized catfish had gathered.
